The '''Hauling Harness''' was a light [[Exoskeleton|cyber-exoskeleton]] favored by [[Quartermaster/Legends|quartermasters]] throughout the [[The galaxy/Legends|galaxy]]. It significantly amplified the user's strength, allowing them to lift and move heavy loads with ease, though at limited speed. While it was less practical than heavy machinery for large-scale tasks, its foldable design made it easy to store when not in use.<ref name="Desperate Allies" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Hauling Harness was first mentioned in ''[[Desperate Allies]]'', a [[Roleplaying game|roleplaying]] supplementary sourcebook for the ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying]]'' series that was published by [[Fantasy Flight Games]] in [[2015]].<ref name="Desperate Allies" />
